note: Verification for the unified reference artifact contract, dynamic fallback, session caching, scale-dependent controls, zoom slider, and metric scale display. Playwright CLI is disabled only because Chromium process creation is blocked by this managed Windows sandbox; equivalent UI flows require connected in-app browser evidence. Production migration and deployment are intentionally excluded.
